## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Explain why the chosen scope is sufficient.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and link relevant CI results. State any checks not performed.
Do not lower coverage/security thresholds or skip checks to make this PR pass.

## Documentation and compatibility

Name the updated guides, examples, skills and changelog entry. For an observable API change,
cover permissions, side effects and retry/recovery behavior. If none changed, explain why.
Run `make docs` when tool registration or annotations change.

## Review (optional; not a merge gate)

If review was performed, record its exact commit, findings and fixes. Otherwise write
"Not performed". Do not claim an automated review or numerical quality score from green CI.

See [QUALITY.md](../QUALITY.md) for the repository's release standard.
